technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot auto-configuration for singlenode binder setup (U7)
Leverage Spring Cloud Stream test binder for in-memory module testing (U1)
Implement YARN SPI using Spring Hadoop integration patterns (U2)
Migrate trigger module with XD-to-SCS adapter layer (U3)
Use Redis Sentinel client libraries for cluster-aware messaging (U4)
Refactor receptor-client against latest Receptor REST/gRPC APIs (U5)
Reuse existing Admin UI components with updated backend endpoints (U6)
Pass YARN container params via Spring property resolution mechanism (U8)
assumptions: Development team has prior experience with Spring Cloud Stream and YARN
Existing test infrastructure can be extended for module-level integration tests
Receptor API documentation is available and stable
Redis Sentinel cluster is accessible for testing purposes
Admin UI client codebase is compatible with current server APIs
All modules follow standard Spring Boot conventions

activities.activity_description: Implement test harness for module wiring, configuration properties, and in-memory message flow assertions using Spring Cloud Stream test binder and Hamcrest matchers
Develop YARN SPI implementation and YARNModuleDeployer strategy for distributed s-c-s module deployment
Move trigger module from Spring XD to s-c-s repository with necessary adapters for streaming pipeline usage
Add Redis Sentinel cluster support as message bus for stream and batch pipeline creation
Upgrade receptor-client to comply with latest Receptor API changes and integrate new features
Ensure existing admin UI client works with spring-cloud-data admin using appropriate server configurations
Create auto-configuration for singlenode binder configuration and properties
Implement support for passing definition parameters into YARN containers for module usage
